075ce95e6a STORY-1916 — https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2859
- AC1 emergency tier (disk_emergency.rs). At >= emergency_used_pct (95) on the build-cache fs, the scheduled run only:
  - deletes idle (>= 2h, newest mtime) direct children of canonical(<main>/target)/worktrees;
  - tier 0 -> 1 -> 2, oldest-idle first; stops below ceiling - margin;
  - re-checks the allowlist with bail! at the delete site;
  - ledgers to .aida/disk-reclaim-ledger.jsonl; notifies via send_direct (disk-emergency).
- C1: non-blocking flock on <cache>/<profile>/.cargo-lock plus a tree re-walk before each delete; busy = skip + ledger; there is a held-flock test.
- C2: tier 2 only while used% >= ceiling; each tier-2 delete mails the holder.
- C3: squash patch-id scan has a 20 s deadline (60 s overall); timeout = unknown/held; tested with Duration::ZERO.
- Guard now also probes the /mnt/build bind mount via statvfs (finding disk-headroom-cache).
- AC2 reclaim: sees the target/worktrees/<name> layout and orphan caches; rail 6 uses the newest write; idle duplicates (branch or take-/pr-<N>) are reclaimed and the freshest/live member is kept; gh-down = git ancestry + squash proof, unproven branches held one by one.
- AC3 stuck: finding says STUCK with reclaimable vs deficit + top 5 consumers; notify disk-stuck deduped (6h or +10 GiB).
- AC4 status: doctor check disk-headroom prints the disk-guard block, and --json carries disk_status (free/used per fs, floor, ceiling, last run, last reclaim).
- Gates: targeted cargo test 69 passed; make check-ci-fast 34 gates passed. Watching CI now.
